message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code only serves local static files and accepts user uploads; it does not fetch data from any remote source (URL, S3, HuggingFace, etc.), so there is no integrity verification or source authentication to evaluate.
No detected label flipping detection: No code validates label distributions, compares label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The pipeline only validates file extension via validFile() and sanitizes the filename with secure_filename(); there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code configures model loading via filenames in config.py (e.g., 'weights-file': 'weights-classification.h5') but performs no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision when loading pretrained weights or serialized models.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or stress tests are referenced anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a holdout test-size split is configured (test-size: 0.2), there is no signing, hashing, or isolation mechanism to protect evaluation data or metrics from tampering.

No detected output bounds checks: There is no visible code in the inference path that checks model outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or other sanity constraints before returning results to the user.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM-based pipeline; it uses neural network models for tabular/CSV data (droplet microfluidics), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and not present.
